subject: HeliosCorp access-accountability: SSO/SCIM/RBAC materials request
messages:
From: Alice Monroe <alice.monroe@helioscorp.com>
To: laura.bennett@redwood.ai
Cc: security@helioscorp.com
Date: Wed, Apr 21, 2027 at 09:12 AM -0700
Subject: SOC2/SIG intake — access controls (SSO/SCIM/RBAC)

Hi Laura,

We're working through our SIG/SOC2 intake for Redwood as part of the Helios procurement review. Security has asked for a focused set of artifacts around access control so we can close the IAM section:

- SAML assertion samples (with identifying attributes) for a sample window (we'd prefer a 30-day slice)
- SCIM delta logs showing provisioning/deprovisioning for the same window
- RBAC ownership matrix (who owns roles / role-to-group mappings)
- A brief narrative on least-privilege controls and how service accounts are handled

Can you confirm whether you can provide these by next Friday (Apr 30)? We attached the SIG questionnaire for context (helios_SIG_questions.xlsx).

Two quick constraints: Helios prefers unredacted assertion attributes where possible, but we will accept PII removed if you provide a clear redaction map. Also note we may ask for timestamps in UTC.

Thanks — looking forward to your intake plan.

Best,
Alice
Alice Monroe
Senior Security Analyst
Helios Corporation

Hi Alice — thanks for the clear ask and for sharing the questionnaire.

High-level intake plan (owners assigned):
- SAML assertion samples (30-day window): Ben to produce redaction-ready samples and a redaction map.
- SCIM delta logs (provision/deprovision events): Jordan to extract deltas and provide CSVs + explanation of event codes.
- RBAC ownership matrix: I will collate owner-to-role mappings and include the role descriptions and current custodians.
- Narrative on least-privilege & service accounts: I will draft a 1-page summary and include a list of service accounts with justification.

Questions for Helios: do you require full, unredacted assertion payloads, or are redacted samples sufficient as long as we supply the mapping? Also, do you have a preferred timestamp format (UTC vs. local)?

Proposed delivery: preliminary artifact bundle by Tue, Apr 27 (internal review), final delivery by Fri, Apr 30. If that timeline works I'll start the collection today.

I've attached a short intake checklist to speed approvals on our side (helix_iam_intake_checklist.xlsx).

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Head of Compliance Operations
Redwood Inference

Laura / Jordan — I'll take the SAML samples and run redaction before sharing. Plan:
- Extract assertion samples for Mar 1 — Apr 1 (30-day window) from the assertion archive.
- Remove cleartext email addresses and replace with deterministic hashes; leave role and group claims intact so Helios can verify mappings.
- Produce a redaction map CSV that shows original attribute types and how they were transformed.
- Package as saml-assertion-samples-redacted.zip and include a short README describing anonymization steps.

I expect to have the first draft of samples and the redaction map by Mon, Apr 26 EOD PST. If Helios insists on fully unredacted payloads we will need an additional NDA addendum and a secured transfer path — please advise.

Ben
Sr. Security Engineer, Redwood Inference

Hi Laura (and team),

Thanks for the quick plan. A few clarifications from Helios:
- We understand the sensitivity and prefer the redacted samples + redaction map. That will be fine as long as the map clearly indicates what was removed/hashed and how to validate integrity.
- Timestamp format: please provide UTC timestamps, and include timezone metadata in the CSV header.
- For SCIM deltas, include the event reason code and identity source (SCIM vs. manual admin action) where available.
- On unredacted payloads: Helios prefers not to receive raw PII unless an explicit justification is supplied and an additional NDA is executed — so we'll accept redacted.

Procurement note (cc): once artifacts are delivered we'll proceed with the SIG intake review. If additional attestation or evidence is required we will open follow-ups.

Appreciate the timeline. We'll look for the preliminary bundle on Apr 27 and final on Apr 30.

Best,
Alice

> Helios Corporation
